question: What is the meaning of prefabrication in relation to deconstructability?
description: Prefabrication in relation to deconstructability refers to the process of constructing building elements off-site and then assembling them on-site using demountable connections. This method allows for easy dismantling and reusing of building components, promoting a circular building approach that supports sustainability by enabling the building to be taken apart without causing damage.
